newsitem.title: UK: TENNIS-DAY SEVEN SNIPPETS FROM WIMBLEDON.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-DAY SEVEN SNIPPETS FROM WIMBLEDON.

text.p: Day seven snippets at Wimbledon on Sunday:
Quote of the day - "I wouldn't mind playing that well if I had a bad back." Britain's Karen Cross, a three-set loser after fourth-seed Iva Majoli had required treatment for a bad back.
Stat of the day - 61. The number of years since a British player won the men's singles title at Wimbledon. Fred Perry was the last champion in 1936.

Sunday opening - The crowd capacity for the middle Sunday, originally reduced on the advice of police and the club's safety officer, was restored to its normal figure of 32,000 after the intended limit of 29,000 was reached in early afternoon.
The generation game - Helena Sukova's next opponent is 16-year-old Russian Anna Kournikova -- a player half her age.
